item.title: Jurors return not-guilty verdict in Mahoning County rape trial
item.description: Testimony began Monday after a jury was picked before Judge Anthony Donofrio in the case against Quentell Elhakim, 30, who is charged with three counts of first-degree felony rape.

item.title: 4 Valley hockey players lead team to state tournament
item.description: Four Valley athletes will compete in the Ohio Hockey State Championship this weekend at Miami University for the Canton Akron Jets.

item.title: Austintown Fitch girls wrestling send three to college level
item.description: Mya Quarles, Yelieishka Perez Navedo, and Kirsten Richard all took part in a signing ceremony Thursday

item.title: Betras sings to commissioners over plan to move offices
item.description: Attorney Dave Betras, who is also the chairman of the Mahoning County Board of Elections, is trying a new strategy to find a new home for the Mahoning County Board of Elections.

item.title: Boardman Trustee says tax levy wasn't placed on ballot on time, will cost township $2M
item.description: A Boardman trustee says a mistake was made that's going to cost the township close to $2 million. The mistake centers around a tax levy that wasn't renewed because the trustees failed to get it on the ballot on time.

item.title: Local Giant Eagle location briefly evacuated
item.description: Firefighters responded to the Giant Eagle in Poland on Thursday morning for a brief evacuation after employees reported smelling "something electrical."

item.title: Ohio bill would allow humans to be composted after death
item.description: An Ohio bill currently under review would allow the "natural organic reduction of remains," which, in simple terms, would legally let humans to be turned into compost after their death, offering another option besides cremation and traditional burial.

item.title: Patrol investigating fatal accident involving bicyclist in Warren Twp.
item.description: The Ohio State Highway Patrol (OSHP) is investigating a fatal accident on Main Avenue in Warren Township.

item.title: Customers report sticker shock with electric bills
item.description: First Energy and Ohio Edison customers have been reaching out to WKBN 27 First News in shock over their utility bills.

item.title: Residents allowed back in homes after gas issue on South Side
item.description: Residents are now being allowed back into their homes after a gas issue at a home on Youngstown's South Side.
